description.value:
Genies no longer rule Calimshan, but their magic is still common in your homeland. Perhaps you accidentally called a djinni out of a magic lamp, or stumbled upon an oasis guarded by a marid. A dao might have rescued you from a landslide, or you bargained with an efreeti for a short-lived fortune. However your path crossed a genie's, the encounter left you with sharp eyes, a silver tongue, and more than a touch of magic.

Ability Scores: Dexterity, Wisdom, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.feats24.Item.phbftMagicInitia]{Magic Initiate} (Wizard)

Skill Proficiencies: Perception and Persuasion

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulGlassblowe]{Glassblower's Tools}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepLightHamme]{Light Hammer}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulGlassblowe]{Glassblower's Tools}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagLamp0000000]{Lamp}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Oil} (3 flasks), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagWaterskin00]{Waterskin}, 2 GP; or (B) 50 GP
